cause: the parameter counter the training readers size a model from counts every encoder-decoder with its encoder, cross-attention and the encoder's front end, a language model with its audio or image tower and projector, and the geometry a config leaves to its class; origin/main normalized an encoder-decoder as one decoder stack at a default width and a multimodal model's text block at a default depth; the ground truth is the whole model

GenZ's training_modeling holds the ModelConfig's decoder-field count to at least the model's own (the serving path's count of the config it was read from); origin/main's ModelConfig was a generic 7B default where its loader could not read the config, or the decoder alone; the ground truth is the whole model

a block that leaves a role of its geometry to its config class is read at the class's (layer_plan.with_class_geometry: BLIP-2's 39-layer tower and 12-layer Q-Former, Qwen2Config's 32 layers, MllamaVisionConfig's 448-pixel image); origin/main read nothing there, or a generic default; the ground truth is transformers' model for the config as shipped

the serving path's weights are the model's own parameter count -- the FRD-027 facts' count of the config the GenZ model was read from (an encoder-decoder's encoder and cross-attention, vision and audio towers, adapters, every expert) -- where origin/main counted the GenZ ModelConfig's decoder fields (a generic 7B default where its loader or converter could not read the config); the ground truth is the whole model

B_eff = (device - weights) // (KV a token x context + a request's fixed bytes): the concurrency follows the weights, KV and fixed bytes it is sized from, each held to its ground truth (origin/main's weights were a generic 7B default, or the decoder fields alone)
MLA caches one latent per token per layer (kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim = 576), not per-head K and V; origin/main charged 128 heads' K and V
MoE placed per layer (first_k_dense_replace dense layers run one FFN), each MoE layer's shared expert and V3.2's indexer graphed; origin/main graphed every layer as MoE
a state-space stack holds no KV cache (a fixed conv and SSM state per sequence); origin/main charged every layer attention's KV
the chunked graph bounds the windowed layers (sliding_window 128) by their window; origin/main read every layer over the whole context

an encoder-decoder's per-token cache is its decoder's self-attention at the decoder's own depth and heads (decoder_layers, decoder_attention_heads); the cross-attention cache over the encoder's 1,500 frames is fixed per sequence
the decoder at its own depth (decoder_layers) and the encoder at its own (encoder_layers, with its convolutional frame embedding and positions); origin/main read the default 32-layer 4096-wide shape
windowed layers (every layer but each 6th, or the stated pattern) bounded by the window
each block's own KV heads (64 / n_heads_in_group) and no cache on its linear-replaced attention blocks; origin/main charged every block 64 heads
GPT-Neo holds no recurrent state; origin/main guessed a Mamba state from its `attention_layers` list
RWKV's state is five hidden-wide vectors per layer, not origin/main's Mamba-shaped guess
the chunked graph's shared expert at its stated width (one 5632-wide expert, not four); its weights are the model's
